entries.9c8dcd3311320b25: It has adopted “One Seiryo” as its slogan and states that it is working to expand corporate value, centered on four basic strategies: “expanding business scale,” “establishing business foundations,” “developing human resources,” and “strengthening corporate culture.” The medium-term management plan positions the period as one for building a management foundation that can secure stable earnings, centered on thorough solutions, and its policy is to deepen existing businesses, develop new businesses, expand stock businesses and develop human resources. In the Information and Communications Systems Business, it states that it is working to capture disaster prevention and mitigation demand, expand sales of water management systems and secure stock businesses such as maintenance; in the Information and Communications Terminal Business, it states that it aims to continue creating stores that customers choose and to improve after-sales service for terminals.
